description: Reads one webinar of the connected WordPress site by its id: title, type, status, host, start date, page address, and whether the emails are already written. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it after wi_list_webinars when the host picked one campaign, before reading its numbers. Never invent an id: take it from wi_list_webinars. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_get_webinar
title: Read one webinar
